crossRefs.note: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and Yahweh sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the…
As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the…
Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

translations.web: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
translations.bsb: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
translations.kjv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
translations.asv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?
